about: Recall cases: repositories a person found that github-scout must find. Each gives the goal as a user would say it, the vocabulary a scan uses (fixed, so runs compare), and the repos the scan must keep. `python evals/run.py` scans every case for real and reports which came back. Add a case whenever someone finds a good repo the tool missed.

evals.prompt: Use github-scout: our operations scripts must read and post on Reddit, X and Xiaohongshu through the Chrome profile we are already logged into, without a model clicking pages.
evals.note: Agents searched 'social media automation' and missed it; a person found it on X. Entity pairs and 'logged-in browser' put it first.

evals.prompt: Use github-scout: let an agent (Opus 5.5) make short explainer videos that show how a machine or a system works.
evals.note: Its own words never say video; people make explainer videos with its interactive figures. Found only by the rising lens.

entities: product launch video|product video|app promo|宣传片|产品视频
motion graphics|motion design|动效|动态图形
mechanisms: programmatic video|video as code|代码做视频
edit decision list|timeline json|剪辑时间线

evals.vocabulary_from: the video-production question, whose scan of 2026-10-15 found it on the rising list

evals.prompt: Use github-scout: find agent skills that search for existing open source before building.
evals.note: A test scan on 2026-10-18 found neither among 525 repos. Its single broad words (github, 开源, skill) returned only giants sorted by stars, and its vocabulary said each idea one way: search-before-build describes itself in Chinese (寻找已经存在的产品、开源项目和可复用组件), and instructa's search-context skill sits in a curated collection whose README says 'reference repositories'.

entities: github search|gh search|github api|GitHub 搜索|GitHub 仓库
claude code|claude-code|coding agent|AI 编程|编程智能体
mechanisms: search first|search-first|search before building|research before coding|先搜索|先搜后写|先调研再开发
reinvent the wheel|reinventing the wheel|reuse before build|reuse first|重复造轮子|复用开源
prior art|existing solutions|existing libraries|现成方案|现成的开源项目|现成的轮子
repo research|github research|open source research|开源调研|开源项目调研|GitHub 项目分析
build vs buy|library selection|compare libraries|技术选型|开源选型

evals.vocabulary_from: the 2026-10-18 draft (entities github|开源|open source, claude code, skill; four mechanism groups), revised by an agent that saw only the scan --plan warnings and the plan skill, not these repos. One change undone: it had put existing solutions first because a code comment said that phrase found a competitor.
